Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Household, washing & chores

lock verb

a door

also lock up, shut up (a house), lock the door, shut the door

classical

Plaut. Aul. 89: abī intrō, occlūde jānuam
Plaut. Most. 425: clāvem cedo atque abī intrō atque occlūde ōstium

occlūdō, occlūdere, occlūsī, occlūsum

verb, third conjugation

shut up, close fast (a door, a house, a shop)

To shoot the bolt is obserāre or pessulum obdere.

Examples

  • Abī intrō, occlūde jānuam. Jam ego hīc erō.

    Go in and lock the door. I’ll be back in a moment.Plaut. Aul. 89

  • clāvem cedo atque abī intrō atque occlūde ōstium

    give me the key, and go in and lock the doorPlaut. Most. 425

See also lock, bolt the door, close, key, door.

SourcesLewis & Short: occludo

Plautus, Aulularia 89; Mostellaria 425.
